question: Can hermit --chaos deterministically surface a schedule-dependent USERSPACE btrfs-progs use-after-free that native/blind execution misses?

target_bug.root_cause: task_start() pthread_detach()s the progress subthread and task_stop() does not pthread_join() it, so task_deinit() frees the shared 'info' object while the subthread is still dereferencing it. The fix is: do not detach, and pthread_join() before task_deinit().

hermit.binary: reflink copy of the primary release build (hermit 0.1)
hermit.note: hermit binary was reflinked from the primary hermit checkout release build; SHA above is the primary checkout HEAD at experiment time

btrfs_progs.modifications: See fix-73e211a7-buggy-vs-fixed.diff and demos/08-btrfs-convert-uaf.md. Two variants (buggy/fixed) built from btrfs-progs v7.1 with an observability harness common to both.

input.note: block size must be >= 4096 or btrfs-convert rejects the image; each run converts a fresh reflink copy of the image
